data.camera: medium shot, practicing dance before rehearsal mirror
data.description: 【星野爱 · 彩排室镜前】彩排室的落地镜前，星野爱一遍遍校准舞步与微笑的弧度，紫色侧发垂落，镜中的偶像连呼吸都掐着节拍——「舞台上的每一秒，都是这样练出来的哦。」
data.promptProse: Ai practices the same dance step before the rehearsal room's full-length mirror, adjusting both her posture and smile in a T-shirt, pleated skirt and sneakers. Her rabbit hair ornament stays fixed beside purple hair. The medium view places the mirror reflection directly behind her and the floor stretching underneath. Window light brightens her shoulders and reflected silhouette, with paired floor shadows emphasizing each carefully measured step.
data.title: 星野爱 · 彩排室镜前
